answer: Score rewards by marginal contribution instead of per head: each submission is compared with everything else filed that epoch, and near-duplicates split one shrinking share. A sybil operator who launches a fleet to farm rewards finds the fleet competing with itself — like many boats crowding one small harbor, each new hull adds congestion, not catch. Genuine work stands apart, cold and distinct as a glacier, and keeps its full value; clones must find a new kernel of real content or earn nothing.
